data.narrative:
Isomorphic Labs is a private-stage biotech company founded by Demis Hassabis that has raised $600M to date. The valuation universe comprises 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Peer-Median triangulation is not applicable: while 7 same-sector private peers exist, none satisfy narrow stage-alignment or valuation-tier filters required for a robust median (minimum 3 datapoints needed). Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because Isomorphic Labs' revenue is not on file—a standard constraint for private company analysis. The public Biotech & Health universe trades at a median P/S multiple of 6.6x across the three listed tickers, but without disclosed target revenue, this multiple cannot be operationalized.

The absence of applicable quantitative triangulation methods reflects the inherent opacity of early-stage private biotech valuations and the difficulty isolating true comparables within a narrow stage-cohort. Further valuation work would require either: (i) confidential revenue or EBITDA disclosure from the target; (ii) access to equity-round pricing from the private peer set; or (iii) transaction multiples from recent financings in the cohort. Until such data materializes, no defensible valuation range can be anchored to this methodology set.
